title: Plan Your Visit
intro: Visiting a church for the first time can feel uncertain. Here is what you can expect at Epiphany.

sections.heading: When should I arrive?
sections.text: Sunday worship begins at 10:00 AM. Arriving 10 to 15 minutes early will give you time to find a seat and settle in.

sections.heading: What should I wear?
sections.text: Whatever you are comfortable wearing. Some people dress up a little and others come casually. You will fit in either way.

sections.heading: What is the service like?
sections.text: Our worship follows the Episcopal tradition: Scripture, prayer, a sermon, music, and Holy Communion. A printed bulletin helps you follow the service from beginning to end.

sections.heading: Can I receive Communion?
sections.text: All baptized Christians are welcome to receive Holy Communion. If you prefer not to receive, you are welcome to come forward for a blessing or simply remain seated.

sections.heading: What happens after worship?
sections.text: We often gather for conversation and refreshments after the service. Visitors are welcome, and there is no pressure to stay.

sections.heading: Still have a question?
sections.text: Contact us before Sunday and we will be glad to help make your first visit easier.
